PM Modi Attends Viksit Bharat Sankalp Sabha, Pledges for 2047

Prime Minister Narendra Modi attended the 'Viksit Bharat Sankalp Sabha' at the Indira Gandhi Stadium, where he received a warm welcome. During the Seva Jyoti Programme, he affirmed "We Will Do It" and pledged for a 'Viksit Bharat' (Developed India) by 2047.
